blurb: Guests can enjoy thrill rides like roller coasters and drop rides, play on four 18-hole miniature golf courses, and explore a large arcade with over 150 games. The park offers rides for various ages and heights, including go-karts, log rides, and a zip line. Food options include pizza, waffles, American classics, and treats like funnel cakes and ICEE drinks.
extraNote: Party minimum 15 paid guests · 24 hour notice and 25% deposit required for birthday parties · No outside food or drink allowed except cake or cupcakes for parties
